title: Project Kraj and Ravnica's Aftermath
summary: Momir Vig's living weapon threatens a city destabilized by the broken Guildpact.
narrative: With the old constraints weakened, guild leaders pursued increasingly dangerous plans to dominate Ravnica.
Teysa Karlov and Agrus Kos became involved in struggles that culminated in the defeat of Momir Vig's Project Kraj, even as the guilds remained politically divided.

The official Ravnican retrospective separates the outcomes: Agrus Kos killed Simic guildmaster Momir Vig; the uncontrolled Project Kraj then went berserk, and Novijen was destroyed. Teysa's political role in the aftermath should not be mistaken for a claim that she personally destroyed Kraj.
